title: Boulders Penguin Colony – Table Mountain National Park – SANParks
facts: The Boulders colony is in Simon’s Town and is managed within Table Mountain National Park.
Boardwalks permit observation of African penguins while limiting disturbance.
SANParks asks visitors not to touch or feed penguins and to remain on viewing boardwalks.
